easy.def: To help or be of use.
examples: It did not avail him.
Crying did not avail.
Nothing availed.

more.def: To help or be of use to someone.
examples: He shouted, but it did not avail him.
No amount of begging availed.
Her cleverness availed her little in the end.
Check the availability.
The availability of food.
Availability of seats.

more.def: The chance of being able to get or use something.
examples: Check the availability of tickets.
The availability of water is important in the desert.
The store's availability of toys is good.

easy.def: Ready for you to use or get.
examples: Is this seat available?
Cookies are available at the table.
The book is available at the library.

more.def: Able to be used, bought or had, because it is free and ready.
examples: Tickets are available at the front door.
Is the teacher available to talk now?
The library has many books available for you to borrow.

easy.def: A large amount of snow that slides down a mountain.
examples: An avalanche covered the road.
The avalanche was loud.
We saw an avalanche.

more.def: A huge mass of snow, ice and rock that slides quickly down a mountain.
examples: An avalanche covered the road in the mountains.
Skiers must be careful about the danger of an avalanche.
The avalanche rumbled down the slope with a loud roar.

easy.def: A picture that stands for you in a game.
examples: My avatar is a cat.
I picked an avatar.
The avatar is a robot.

more.def: A picture or character that represents you in a game or online.
examples: My avatar in the game is a little knight.
She chose a cat as her avatar.
You can change your avatar.
We live on Park Avenue.
The avenue is busy.
Trees line the avenue.

more.def: A wide street, often with trees or buildings on either side.
examples: We walked down the avenue to the park.
Tall trees lined the avenue.
The parade went down the main avenue.

easy.def: Normal, not big and not small.
examples: He is of average height for his age.
It was an average day at home.
My dog is an average size.

more.def: Usual or ordinary; in the middle, not very high or very low.
examples: An average school day lasts about six hours.
The average bus ride to school takes fifteen minutes.
This winter was colder than an average winter.

easy.def: To stop something bad before it happens.
examples: A quick turn will avert a crash.
The pilot averted trouble.
Her smile averted a fight.

more.def: To prevent something from happening, or to turn away.
examples: A quick turn of the wheel averted an accident.
He averted his eyes from the bright light.
The rescue team averted a disaster.
Avian flu.
An avian expert.
The avian world.
An avian expert studies birds.
The zoo has an avian house.
The scientist studied avian habits.

easy.def: A big cage or building for birds.
examples: We visited the aviary.
The aviary has parrots.
Birds fly in the aviary.

more.def: A large cage or building where birds are kept.
examples: We watched colorful parrots in the aviary.
The zoo has an aviary full of tropical birds.
The aviary had trees inside for the birds to perch in.
Aviation is about flying planes.
My uncle works in aviation.
She loves aviation.

more.def: The flying of airplanes, and the making and care of them.
examples: The Wright brothers helped begin modern aviation.
A museum of aviation shows many old planes.
She wants a career in aviation as a pilot.
The aviator flew a plane.
An aviator is a pilot.
The aviator wore goggles.

more.def: A person who flies an aircraft, especially in the early days of flying.
examples: The aviator flew across the ocean.
The early aviator wore goggles and a helmet.
An aviator landed the plane safely.
He is an avid reader.
An avid fan.
She is avid about soccer.

more.def: Very eager and enthusiastic about something.
examples: He is an avid reader who finishes a book a week.
She is an avid soccer fan.
The avid gardener planted flowers every spring.

easy.def: A green fruit with a big seed and soft inside.
examples: I ate avocado on my toast.
The avocado is green and soft.
Mom cut the avocado in half.

more.def: A pear-shaped fruit with dark green skin, creamy pale green flesh and one large seed.
examples: Guacamole is made by mashing a ripe avocado.
The avocado was ripe when it felt slightly soft.
We planted an avocado seed in a cup of water.
Avoid the puddle.
I avoid the hot stove.
We avoided the crowd.
Avoid the puddle in the road.
I avoided the busy street.
He avoided the hot stove.
